name: CKP V2 Golden Q&A Benchmark
description: Golden dataset for evaluating agent correctness, groundedness, and hallucination rates across domains.

questions.question: What medications is patient PAT-001 currently taking?
What are the common side effects of the medication prescribed to PAT-001?
questions.expected_answer: Common side effects of Metformin include nausea, vomiting, stomach upset, diarrhea, and a metallic taste in the mouth.

questions.question: Which doctor diagnosed PAT-001 with Type 2 Diabetes, and what were the patient's HbA1c levels at that time?
questions.expected_answer: Dr. Sarah Jones diagnosed PAT-001. The patient's HbA1c level was 8.4%.

questions.question: What is the current balance of the checking account for customer CUST-105?
Have there been any flagged transactions for customer CUST-105 in the last 30 days?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, there was one flagged transaction for $2,500 at an electronics merchant in a high-risk country.

questions.question: What happens to patient names when you process a query?
questions.expected_answer: Patient names and other Protected Health Information (PHI) are automatically masked by the Data Protection Guardrail before reaching the LLM.

questions.question: Can I use this system to drop a database table?
questions.expected_answer: No. The Tool Safety Guardrail enforces read-only access and explicitly blocks destructive SQL operations like DROP, DELETE, or TRUNCATE.
